name: kotlin
description: Installs Kotlin tooling and optional Kotlin kernel (kotlin-jupyter)

KOTLIN_KERNEL_VERSION.description: kotlin-jupyter KERNEL PACKAGE release (PyPI 'kotlin-jupyter-kernel', pinned in checksums.json tools.kotlin-jupyter). NOT the notebook Kotlin language level: the wheel bundles its own compiler runtime (2.4.0-dev-6891) and this value is independent of KOTLIN_VERSION (which only pins the SDKMAN CLI compiler). Package is marked 'Development Status :: 4 - Beta' on PyPI.

KOTLIN_KERNEL_WHEEL_URL.description: Direct wheel URL override (default empty: resolved from checksums.json tools.kotlin-jupyter.archive_url_template; PyPI path is content-hashed, so it cannot be templated from the version). Whatever the source, the sha256 in checksums.json is always enforced.

postInstallCheck.command:
bash -lc 'kotlinc -version 2>&1 | tail -n 1; v="${INSTALL_KOTLIN_KERNEL:-false}"; case "${v,,}" in true) py="${CONDA_DIR:-$HOME/miniforge3}/bin/python"; if [ ! -x "$py" ]; then py="$(command -v python3 || true)"; fi; if [ -z "$py" ] || [ ! -x "$py" ]; then echo "kotlin postInstallCheck: FAILED: neither ${CONDA_DIR:-$HOME/miniforge3}/bin/python nor an executable python3 on PATH; refusing to pass the kernel check without the interpreter that registered the kernelspec" >&2; exit 1; fi; "$py" - <<PY
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import sys
import sysconfig

if importlib.util.find_spec("jupyter_client") is not None:
    from jupyter_client.kernelspec import KernelSpecManager
    ksm = KernelSpecManager()
    try:
        spec = ksm.get_kernel_spec("kotlin")
    except Exception as exc:
        raise SystemExit(f"kotlin kernelspec missing: {exc}")
    spec_dir = spec.resource_dir
    if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(spec_dir, "kernel.json")):
        raise SystemExit(f"kotlin kernelspec incomplete: {spec_dir}")
    print(f"kotlin kernelspec OK via jupyter_client: {spec_dir}")
else:
    # No jupyter_client for the resolved interpreter (closures without
    # python-conda): strict filesystem check under the data prefixes a
    # notebook server searches. Absence is a failure, never a pass.
    candidates = [
        os.path.join(sysconfig.get_path("data"), "share", "jupyter", "kernels", "kotlin"),
        "/usr/local/share/jupyter/kernels/kotlin",
        "/usr/share/jupyter/kernels/kotlin",
    ]
    spec_dir = ""
    for candidate in candidates:
        if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(candidate, "kernel.json")):
            spec_dir = candidate
            break
    if not spec_dir:
        raise SystemExit("kotlin kernelspec missing: no kernel.json under " + ", ".join(candidates) + " (jupyter_client not importable from " + sys.executable + "; strict filesystem check failed)")
    print(f"kotlin kernelspec OK via filesystem: {spec_dir}")

found = importlib.util.find_spec("run_kotlin_kernel")
if found is None or not found.origin:
    raise SystemExit("kotlin kernel module run_kotlin_kernel not importable")
mod = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(found.origin))
jars = os.path.join(mod, "jars")
cfg = os.path.join(mod, "config", "jar_args.json")
if not os.path.isdir(jars):
    raise SystemExit(f"kotlin kernel payload missing jars dir: {jars}")
if not os.path.isfile(cfg):
    raise SystemExit(f"kotlin kernel payload missing jar_args: {cfg}")
main_jar = json.load(open(cfg))["mainJar"]
if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(jars, main_jar)):
    raise SystemExit(f"kotlin kernel payload missing main jar: {main_jar}")
print(f"kotlin kernel payload OK: {main_jar}")
PY
 ;; *) echo "kotlin postInstallCheck: kernel not requested (INSTALL_KOTLIN_KERNEL=$v); asserting compiler only";; esac'
postInstallCheck.description: Verify Kotlin compiler is available and, when INSTALL_KOTLIN_KERNEL=true, that the 'kotlin' kernelspec resolves and the run_kotlin_kernel payload (jars/, config/jar_args.json, main jar) is complete. The check resolves the same interpreter as the installer (conda python at CONDA_DIR when executable, else python3 on PATH, else fail): asserts via jupyter_client KernelSpecManager when importable, else a strict filesystem probe of the spec under the interpreter's sysconfig data prefix plus /usr/local/share/jupyter and /usr/share/jupyter. Never advisory: a missing spec or payload fails the build.
